newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Brown Bros ups N.Y. Times.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Brown Bros ups N.Y. Times.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers analyst Maryann Winter said she raised New York Times Co to buy from hold on a short-term basis.
-- She retained her long-term outperform rating.
-- The analyst said she raised earnings estimates for the media company in 1996 to $1.75 from $1.70 per share, while she boosted her 1997 estimate to $2.10 per share from $1.90.
-- Citing rapidly declining newsprint pricing and the benefits of past employee buyouts, Winters said she expected the company to have an "extremely good" outlook for the next three to four quarters.
-- She set a one-year stock price target in the range of $38 to $42, with $38 as a short-term target.
-- The stock stood at 32-5/8 in early trading Friday, unchanged from the previous day's close.
